release.title: Classic Visual System, Approved Brand Assets, and Three-Market Professional Growth
release.artifactSha256Location: External exact-artifact test record and final delivery summary

changes.problem: The inherited interface still used oversized heroes, broad gradients, excessive rounded surfaces, and heavier prototype-like visual treatment.
changes.implementation: Applied a shared white/near-white classic professional token and component override with smaller typography, restrained accents, clearer controls, reduced radii/shadows, visible focus, touch targets, and reduced-motion safeguards while preserving routes and layouts.

changes.problem: The approved logo and favicon existed but the release lacked a complete technical brand package for raster fallbacks, touch icons, manifests, and social sharing.
changes.implementation: Preserved the approved SVG identity and generated required technical variants from the repository masters, added a brand provenance note, web manifest, and consistent HTML metadata references.

changes.problem: The public directory was concentrated in Brooklyn and did not satisfy the new three-market growth standard.
changes.implementation: Added 25 source-tracked individual professionals, 5 firms, and 25 professional–firm links across Brooklyn, Manhattan, and Northern Metro New Jersey; enriched one existing Brooklyn firm; preserved unclaimed/unverified/nonparticipating status.

changes.problem: Users had no direct three-market entry points and no county/service-region filter.
changes.implementation: Added public market cards, county/service-region filtering, shareable filter state, and owner-visible batch targets/actuals without inventing radius results or paid ranking.

changes.problem: Unauthenticated protected-page redirects safely denied access but did not carry the noindex response header applied to the destination page.
changes.implementation: Added X-Robots-Tag noindex, nofollow, noarchive to owner/staff access redirects and extended the inherited security regression.

profileGrowth.sourcePolicy: Professional-controlled official firm websites were used for current public identity, office, and service facts. Credential status remains unverified until official licensing review. No commercial ratings, reviews, outcome claims, or inferred specialties were copied.
excludedOrDeferred: No new profile outside Brooklyn, Manhattan, or Northern Metro New Jersey.
Profiles without individual-level service evidence or a current published business office were deferred.
Radius search remains closed until verified coordinates and distance rules exist.

tests.covers: classic visual tokens, approved logo preservation, complete brand assets, metadata, manifest, focus and reduced motion
profile target and actual counts, source and portal relevance, firm links, market search, claim readiness, owner accountability
version consistency, records, runtime boundaries, exact profile totals, brand/public routes, and closed gates

closedGates: sensitive external AI without approved controls
